headline: NYY @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 5.27 at TOR 3.46, with a projected total of 8.73. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYY: NYY moved +0.68 runs while TOR moved +0.21, changing the projected margin by +0.47 runs. The projected total climbed +0.89, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -9.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Will Warren has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Ernie Clement, Kazuma Okamoto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ali Sánchez, Max Schuemann because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
